name: 像素位平面分析
description: Analyzes bit plane patterns for hidden artifacts
algorithm: Pixel Bit Plane — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes pixel bit planes for image forensic analysis following the steganalysis framework of Fridrich & Kodovsky (2012):

1. **BitPlane分解**: Each pixel value is decomposed into its constituent bit planes (8 bit planes for 8-bit images). Each bit plane is a binary image representing one bit position across all pixels. Higher bit planes carry structural information; lower bit planes carry fine detail and noise.

2. **BitPlaneStatistics**: Statistical properties of each bit plane are analyzed — randomness (entropy), spatial correlation, and pattern regularity. In natural images, lower bit planes approach random binary noise while higher bit planes show image structure. AI-generated images may show different bit plane statistics — especially in lower planes where the generator's quantization produces non-random patterns.

3. **BitPlane相关性分析**: The correlation between adjacent bit planes is measured. Natural camera images show specific inter-plane correlation patterns arising from the sensor's analog-to-digital conversion. AI-generated pixels don't arise from A/D conversion and may show different inter-plane correlations.

4. **LSBPlane分析**: The least significant bit (LSB) plane receives special attention. In natural images, the LSB plane appears quasi-random. AI generators, depending on their output quantization method, may produce LSB planes with: residual patterns, reduced entropy, or spatial correlations that reveal the generation process.

5. **Multi-PlaneFeature评分**: Features from all bit planes are combined into a forensic score. The score captures bit plane entropy ratios, inter-plane correlation anomalies, and spatial regularity in individual planes.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： 像素 bit plane 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
